hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '\.(env|env\.local|env\.production|credentials)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Cannot write to sensitive files (.env, credentials)' >&2; exit 2; fi
file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oP '"file_path"\s*:\s*"\K[^"]+'); if [ -n "$file" ] && echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$'; then echo "TypeScript file modified: $file"; fi
